result:
Two claims in this draft aren't on the brand's approved list.

1. **"Most subscribers stay with us for over a year."** This is a retention statistic. The policy doesn't back it, so it counts as an invented stat. It also sits oddly beside the pause-or-cancel message.
2. **"means most boxes ship free."** The policy supports free UK delivery on orders over £25. It doesn't support the claim that most boxes qualify, which is an unsupported statistic about order values.

The pause-or-cancel claim and the free-delivery-over-£25 claim are both approved and fine as written. A safe rewrite would be: "Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25."
